known_facts: Reuters exclusive published 2026-10-13 05:02 UTC says US bank supervisors are asking banks about advanced AI model usage, agent control and Chinese technology.
European supervisors including ECB and Bank of England are pressing for better recovery planning due to AI-related disruption risks.
No new binding AI-specific banking regulation is confirmed by this reporting.
